name: Mandelbulb Sphere Tracing
definition: Sphere tracing applied to the Mandelbulb fractal. Uses a specific distance estimator function `distMandelBulb` instead of a generic shape distance function.
summary: Mandelbulb Sphere Tracing renders the Mandelbulb fractal by raymarching through 3D space using an iterative spherical power Signed Distance Function, differing from standard tracing by replacing simple geometry with this complex fractal boundary approximation.
